description: Still water over a geodat bed (G 9 1, G 10 1: a Gaussian hump from geo.dat, the bed level of every level-0 column, GEOB) with two refined levels over the hump (G 1 2, G 15 below the free surface): the patches cast the bed as the surface through the level-0 column centres (2D: a polyline; the exact distance in a band of 5 cells, below it inside), not the prolonged level-0 distance. The water stays at rest.
covers: cfd_amr::geom_setup: the geodat bed of all level-0 columns gathered (gbed0)
cfd_amr::patch_bed in 2D (polyline, the edge column held beyond the outermost centres)
